title: Using words instead of hitting
examples: What do I do when I want to hit?
How do I stop myself hitting?
What can I say when I am angry?

explain.say: Sometimes a feeling gets so big that your hands want to do the talking. Lots of people feel that. Look at the board. On the left, hitting. On the right, using words.
See the left side? Hitting. It hurts someone. They feel scared. And nobody knows why you were cross. So the problem stays. Have you ever felt your hands want to hit?
Now the right side. Using words. You say, I feel cross! Then others understand. And you can fix the problem together. Words are strong. Which side helps you get what you need?
Here is what to do. See the hand? Stop. Freeze like a statue. Then hands down, by your sides or in your pockets. Then one big breath. Can you freeze like a statue right now?

faq.q: What do I do when I want to hit?
faq.a: Stop and freeze. Put your hands down by your sides or in your pockets. Take one big breath. Then use words or get a grown-up.

faq.q: What words can I use when I am angry?
faq.a: You can say, I feel cross! or Stop, I do not like that, or I need a break. A grown-up you trust can help.

faq.q: Is it wrong to feel angry?
faq.a: No. Feeling angry is okay. Everyone feels it. Hitting is not okay, because it hurts people. Words help instead.
asks: Am I wrong to be angry?

faq.q: What if I already hit someone?
faq.a: Stop, and get a grown-up. When you are calm, you can say sorry and talk about what to do next time. Everyone can learn.

faq.q: Why do my hands want to hit?
faq.a: Big feelings fill your body with energy. Your hands want to let it out. Squeezing a ball or pushing a wall is a safe way.
asks: Why do I want to hit?

facts: Angry feelings can make the heart beat faster and muscles tighten.
Naming a feeling with words, like I feel cross, can help it settle.

quiz.say: Your hands want to hit. What is the first step?
quiz.why: Freezing stops your hands before anyone gets hurt.

wrong.1: Any hitting can hurt. Stop and freeze instead.
wrong.2: Shouting can upset people. Freeze and breathe.

quiz.say: Which words can you use when you feel cross?
quiz.why: Naming your feeling helps others understand and help.

wrong.1: Saying something helps others know what is wrong.
wrong.2: That can hurt feelings. Name your feeling instead.
